cards.front: What does Error: Could not find or load main class X tell you?
cards.back: The launcher could not resolve X on the classpath — the class file is missing there, or the name omits its package prefix
cards.extra: javac was fine; this is a lookup failure at launch. The follow-up line Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: X names what was missing. java -cp out pkg.Main finds it, java Main or a wrong -cp does not.
cards.example:
java -cp out Main        // Error: Could not find or load main class Main
java -cp out pkg.Main    // runs

cards.front: A class is on the classpath but has no valid main. Which error does the launcher print?
cards.back: Error: Main method not found in class Foo — not "could not find or load main class"
cards.extra: The two messages point at different faults: this one means the class was loaded and the entry point was rejected, so the signature must be public static void main(String[] args). A non-static main or one with no parameter triggers it.
cards.example:
public class NoMain { public void main() { } }
// Error: Main method not found in class NoMain, please define the main method as:
//    public static void main(String[] args)
